title: Sealed push payload (the plaintext inside the envelope)
description: Serialized as RFC 8785 JSON, padded to 512, 1024 or 2048 bytes. Readers ignore unknown keys and treat null as absent.

server.description: The app's own reference for the server, from registerDevice.

exp.description: Unix seconds; equal to the envelope's exp.

pending.description: Pending permission requests and forms on the server.

rootSessionID.description: The root of the session's family; equal to sessionID for a root session.

title.description: Session title, at most 100 code points.

project.description: Project folder name, at most 60 code points.

action.description: Permission action, at most 64 code points.

summary.description: Command, path, question or error, at most 300 code points.

options.description: Option labels of the first question field: at most 8, each at most 40 code points.

risk.description: Risk tier from risk-rules.json. Readers treat any other value as high.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the request (README, "Digest").

freeText.description: The form has one field and it accepts typed text.

reply.description: resolved only: once, always or reject for a permission; answered or cancelled for a form; cancelled for a permission that ended without an answer.
